scope: Additive recheck of permanent Home Village Hero Banner defense evidence. It does not enable a defensive Hero proxy.
game_version: Public sources consulted on 2026-09-20. The standard Home Village battle contract remains the target.

sources.title: Get Ready for Ranked! - Update
facts: Tournament Mode gives defending Heroes 20 percent additional DPS.
Tournament Mode gives defending Heroes 20 percent additional hitpoints.
The same mode reduces attacking Hero DPS and hitpoints.
sources.limitations: The page scopes all four modifiers to Tournament Mode and supplies no standard-battle Hero Banner patrol, targeting, return, respawn or tick-order contract.

sources.title: Hero Banner
facts: One Hero is assigned to one Hero Banner.
Grand Warden defends on the ground while Minion Prince and Dragon Duke defend flying.
sources.limitations: The page could not be opened directly because of robots restrictions. Search excerpts are insufficient to define route, range, collision, targeting or timing.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply the 20 percent defending Hero DPS and hitpoint modifiers to ordinary Home Village battles.
rejected_inferences.reason: The primary source explicitly scopes them to Tournament Mode. The current phase does not model that mode.

rejected_inferences.rule: Create Banner patrol or chase behavior from community descriptions.
rejected_inferences.reason: No reproducible numeric patrol radius, acquisition boundary, return rule or deterministic ordering is available.

items: standard battle defensive Hero attack and hitpoint modifiers
patrol radius, route and idle behavior
target acquisition, pursuit, return and respawn
wall interaction, collision and same-tick ordering
Grand Warden defense-mode target and support rules

conclusion: The recheck finds no source-supported deterministic standard Home Village Hero Banner contract. Tournament Mode modifiers are preserved as out-of-mode evidence and are not silently applied to the standard simulation.
